messages:
Maya D: Quick pass before I sign off — handing over this active watch. Root alert is `embeddings-queue-surge` (P2). Started ~10m ago.

Maya D: Customer impact: intermittent 502s for some EU embedding requests (~10% of eu-west traffic). No data loss. Affected model: `embed-large-v2` on eu-west1.

ops-bot: ALERT triggered: embeddings-queue-surge (rule: queue_latency > 2s for 5m) — 1758649800 — @oncall_eng

Maya D: Mitigations in-flight: autoscaler manual bump (4 -> 16), prefetch/prefix-cache warmup for hot keys, and temporary routing rule to shift non-critical customers to `embed-large-v1-fallback` in us-west while we stabilize eu.

Jon P: On it — I see crashloops on 3/16 new workers, OOM in process `embed-worker` right after init. Pulling last 100 lines of logs now.

Jon P: logs snippet:
```
I092 12:03:12.345 embed_worker.go:213] init cache: success
I092 12:03:13.001 runtime: out of memory
panic: runtime: out of memory
```

Sabrina L: Could be a memory bump in the new container image (2.1.0). We rolled that out in eu-west two deploys ago. Canary looked fine at low qps.

Maya D: Runbook ref: /runbooks/embeddings/queue-memory (follow steps under "autoscaler fail & OOM"). Key steps already done: scaled nodes, scaled pods. Not done: revert to previous image on eu-west, or pin autoscaler to max 8 while we root cause.

Kai R: My suggestion: set autoscaler max to 8 to avoid flash scale that triggers OOM, and revert image to 2.0.7 on eu-west. Then warm caches. If that reduces 502s, we can slowly increase.

Elena T: I'll prepare the image revert canary. ETA ~6m. Will start with a single zone canary (eu-west1-b) then watch p99.

Maya D: Coverage: I'm primary until 18:00 UTC. Jon, you are secondary for the next 2h. If anything escalates to P1, page the pager AND DM me.

Jon P: Acknowledged. I'll watch metrics and error budget. Setting alert snooze for noisy flaps + creating short-lived alert: `embeddings-pod-crashloop` to avoid paging for symptom noise.

Sabrina L: Customer comms: No proactive email yet. If 20%+ users impacted or 30m+ sustained, we flag CSMs. I'll draft a short note in #customer-success-template if needed.

Maya D: Current quick checklist for the incoming shift (copy/paste):
- Primary/Secondary: Maya D (primary until 18:00 UTC), Jon P (secondary for next 2h)
- Active alerts: embeddings-queue-surge (P2), embeddings-pod-crashloop (new, monitoring)
- Mitigations in progress: autoscaler bumped -> causing OOMs; reverting image to 2.0.7; temp routing to fallback model for non-critical tenants
- Immediate actions for next oncall: watch EU p50/p95/p99 latency, check pod OOM rates, confirm canary revert results, and disable aggressive autoscaler once canary stable
- Runbook link: /runbooks/embeddings/queue-memory
- Logs & commands: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embed-worker -o wide` and `kubectl -n inference logs <pod> -c embed-worker --tail=200`

Jon P: Starting the autoscaler cap change now: `kubectl patch hpa embeddings --patch '{"spec": {"maxReplicas": 8}}'`

ops-bot: action logged: hpa patch by Jon P at 1758650010

Elena T: Canary deploy started (eu-west1-b) — reverting container from 2.1.0 -> 2.0.7 for embed-worker. Will report health at +3m and +10m.

Maya D: If revert stabilizes, we'll roll forward with controlled ramp and update routing back. If not, escalate to infra and consider node-type fallback (move some pods to larger memory instance pool).

Jon P: Noted. I see crashloop count decreasing on canary pod already (was 3/min, now 0/5m). p99 latency trending down from 1.9s -> 1.1s on canary slice.

Sabrina L: :thumbsup: If metrics continue to improve for 10m, I'll prepare a short status update for #eng-status and mention CSM hold.

Maya D: Coverage gap: after I sign off, primary will be Jon. I'm leaving a pinned checklist in this thread. If anyone picks up for night shift, please confirm you have runbook access and the ability to rollback images.

Kai R: Quick note — if you need to route traffic quickly, we have a routing rule ready named `route-embed-eu-to-fallback` (disabled). It can be toggled in console under Traffic > Rules. Use with caution (increases token cost).

Elena T: Canary + autoscaler cap both seem good at +8m. I'll keep monitoring.

Jon P: I'll hold until 18:00 UTC then pass to night primary. For now, no immediate escalation.

Maya D: Thanks team — leaving now. Jon, you're on top of this.

Maya D: (reacted with :wave:)
